answer_2.quote: We report the per-class F1 score and overall F1 score across all 4 settings. We select Macro F1 for overall performance as it treats all classes equally... For verification (RQ2), we use response accuracy for measuring performance.

answer_4.quote: We carefully pick and curate real-world image-text pairs with expert human annotations... DisRel: with labels collected through crowdsourcing on Amazon MTurk... Tweet Subtitles: expert annotators... CLUE: expert annotators...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators assigned coherence relations based on predefined categories and communicative functions (e.g., Similar, Complementary, Insertion, etc.).
